meta.title: Ori - Achieve your goals without sacrificing your life
meta.description: Ori is an AI self-development coach. Any AI can write you a plan; Ori is built for the week it breaks - it notices, reshapes the path to your real capacity, and gets you moving again. No backlog, no guilt.
meta.og_description: AI can build your plan. Ori is why you still have it in month six.
meta.schema: An AI self-development coach that plans around your real capacity and rebuilds the path when that capacity changes.

hero.h1: Achieve your goals without sacrificing your life.
hero.lede: Any AI can write you a plan. Ori is built for the week it breaks - it notices when life gets in the way, reshapes the path to what you can really do, and gets you moving again. No backlog. No guilt.
hero.note: Early access opens in the Czech Republic and Slovakia first. We'll write when your spot is ready - privacy.

phone.label: An example of Ori re-planning a day
phone.says: Heavy week at work. Your long run moved to Saturday morning - tonight, a 15-minute mobility session keeps the streak alive.

problem.h2: Everyone can make a plan now. Almost nobody finishes one.
problem.c1_p: Any AI writes a credible roadmap in seconds. That stopped being the hard part.
problem.c2_p: A crunch at work, a bad week, one skipped session. The plan assumes a constant version of you that does not exist.
problem.c3_p: Every tool waits for you to come back and face an untouched backlog. Most people never come back.
problem.statement: We spend more time managing our lives than improving them.

how.h2: Every app can build the plan. Ori is built for the week it breaks.
how.setup_h: Twenty minutes, then Ori does the planning
how.setup_p: Your goal, your starting point, why it matters to you and how much time you really have. Ori turns it into a roadmap of milestones and plans the next few days of sessions around your actual calendar.
how.s1_p: You went quiet. Ori sees it. You never have to report your own failure.
how.s2_p: Skipped sessions and missing check-ins are the reading. One question confirms it.
how.s3_p: Ori changes the scope and the activity itself, not only the date. A quick win instead of deep work.
how.s4_p: You carry on from where you are. Same goal, different path, no guilt.
how.loop: Every cycle teaches Ori your real pace. Month six is a different product than day one.

why.h2: Built on behaviour change, not engagement.
why.lede: When your capacity changes, the plan changes - not the goal.
why.p1_h: We shrink the task, we don't just move it
why.p1_p: A rescheduled task is the same wall a day later. A smaller one gets done - and doing something is what restarts the habit.
why.p2_p: Coming back after a bad week is a shame problem, not a motivation problem. Ori reaches out first, so the moment of return never arrives.
why.p3_p: Passion or pressure, ambition or capacity. The intake shapes the roadmap, because a plan built on the wrong motivation dies in week three.
why.p4_p: Not just the free slot in your calendar. Burnout prevention is a scheduling rule here, not a wellness section.
why.statement: Engagement-optimised apps succeed when you are in the app. Ori succeeds when you are doing the thing outside it.

who.h2: For people who want a system that adapts to them - not the other way around.
who.a_h: Ambitious, and out of decisions by 6 pm
who.a_1: Stuck in decision fatigue after work.
who.a_2: Can't start the side project, because working out where to begin is itself exhausting.
who.a_3: Want the next step handed to them, sized for the evening they actually have.
who.b_h: High performers who've burned out before
who.b_1: A track record of delivering - and a personal project recently dropped to burnout or time.
who.b_2: Looking for a system that survives the weeks they can't deliver.
who.b_3: Want to be pushed on good days and protected on bad ones.

privacy.title: Privacy - Ori
privacy.description: How Ori handles the email address you give us when you join the waitlist.
privacy.collect_p: When you join the waitlist, we keep your email address and the time you joined. Nothing else - the form has no other fields, and this website uses no analytics or advertising cookies.
privacy.why_p1: To tell you when early access to Ori is ready for you, and about Ori's launch. We don't sell or share your address, and we don't send you anything unrelated to Ori.
privacy.why_p2: We process it because you asked us to (your consent, GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw that at any time.
privacy.where_p: In a database run for us by Supabase, our database provider. The page's fonts are served by this website itself, so no third party sees your visit.
privacy.long_p: Until you ask us to remove it, or until we no longer need it to invite you - after Ori's public launch we clear the list.
privacy.rights_p: You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it - write to oriapp.eu@gmail.com from the address you signed up with and we'll do it. If you think we've handled your data wrongly, please tell us first at the same address - we'll look into it and put it right. You also always have the right to complain to the Czech data protection authority, the Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů.
privacy.app_p: This page covers only this website and its waitlist. Once you use the Ori app itself, its own privacy policy applies, which you see when you create an account.
